items.title: NVDA Stock: Where Compounding Could Take The Price
items.summary: This is no longer just a chip company; it is becoming the central bank for the AI revolution. NVIDIA is helping establish financing platforms to raise over $500 billion of third-party capital for its customers. It has also directly invested nearly $50 billion in the Frontier AI labs, effectively underwriting its own demand.

items.title: How Investors May Respond To QCOM Naming Sergio Buniac To Lead Mobile, Compute And Personal AI
items.summary: Qualcomm has appointed former Motorola Devices president Sergio Buniac as executive vice president and group general manager of Mobile, Compute and Personal AI, placing him in charge of its smartphone, PC, wearables, XR and new AI device businesses from early September 2026. This leadership change comes as Qualcomm faces rising costs and concerns about reduced iPhone modem share, while it works to expand into data center and AI markets.
